assessments.reasoning: The exact W3C history title and Recommendation row identify SPARQL 1.1 Query Language and the March 21, 2013 publication. The independently acquired date-specific text names the same language for querying RDF.

challenge.method: Compare the history’s Recommendation link to the dated text’s title, self-link and abstract. Check the separate publisher Query, Update, Protocol and RDF Concepts documents for competing identity interpretations.
challenge.results: The Query title, date and RDF-query subject agree across issuer representations. The working group family includes independently titled Update and Protocol records. A language link through the dated Query Recommendation does not transfer those scopes.

limitations: The scope is the Query language referent identified through its 2013 Recommendation. Other language editions, the related Update language, RDF representations and service interfaces retain their own identities and scopes.
